description: The line plot illustrates the loss values over iterations for three different configurations of the SepLLM model, with the x-axis representing the number of iterations (#Iteration) on a linear scale ranging from approximately 95,000 to 125,000, and the y-axis representing the loss on a linear scale from 2.0 to 3.0. The plot includes three distinct lines: a pink dashed line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", a blue solid line labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", and an orange dashed line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)". All three lines start at a loss of approximately 3.0 at the beginning of the iterations and exhibit a sharp initial decline, with the pink line showing the steepest drop. The blue and orange lines follow a similar trend, converging and stabilizing around a loss of 2.4 after about 100,000 iterations. The pink line continues to decrease slightly, ending at a loss of approximately 2.2, while the blue and orange lines stabilize around 2.3. A horizontal red dashed line at a loss of 2.4 is also present, indicating a threshold or target value. The legend in the top right corner identifies each line by its color, marker style, and label.
